default.panel_subheading: Claiming your lane and making it undeniably yours.
default.panel_description: Ownership is about staking your claim in the market. We define your unique point of view, identify the specific intersection of topics you should own, and build the messaging framework that makes your voice consistent, recognizable, and impossible to ignore. Examples include but are not limited to:

cards.heading: Executive Positioning Workshop
cards.description: 90-minute facilitated session to define your unique perspective, core beliefs, and the 3-5 topics you will own in your market.

cards.heading: Messaging & Narrative Guide
cards.description: A fully developed executive messaging guide: your story, positioning statement, key messages, and proof points.

cards.heading: Topic Pillar Definition
cards.description: 3-5 defined content pillars mapped to your expertise and audience needs, with 10+ content ideas per pillar.

cards.heading: Competitive White-Space Analysis
cards.description: Analysis of what peers and competitors are saying, identifying the white space for you to own.

cards.heading: Visual Identity Assets
cards.description: Brand-aligned visual assets and written assets for LinkedIn, your website bio, and event profiles.

cards.heading: Positioning Refresh (Annual)
cards.description: Annual review and refresh of your point of view and messaging to stay ahead of industry shifts.

default.panel_subheading: Turning your expertise into content that moves the market.
default.panel_description: Insights is the content engine. We extract your ideas through interviews and collaboration, then transform them into a steady stream of high-quality content, so you show up consistently without it consuming your time. Examples include but are not limited to:

cards.heading: Executive POV Workshop
cards.description: 60-minute recorded session with an MDCo strategist to extract ideas, reactions to trends, and original perspectives each month.

cards.heading: Ghostwritten Thought Leadership Posts
cards.description: Ghost-written, voice-matched posts across your topic pillars. Delivered for review and approval before publishing.

cards.heading: Bylined Article Placement
cards.description: 800-1,200 word bylined article for LinkedIn, your company blog, or trade press submission.

cards.heading: Executive Newsletter Column
cards.description: Monthly executive column contribution to the MDCo eNewsletter and/or MarketDesign Voices program.

cards.heading: Rapid-Response Commentary
cards.description: Rapid-response content when industry news breaks, positioning you as a timely, relevant voice within 24-48 hours.

cards.heading: Quarterly Content Calendar
cards.description: Rolling 90-day content plan mapped to industry events, award cycles, and seasonal business topics.

default.panel_subheading: Building relationships that amplify your reach and reputation.
default.panel_description: Community is where thought leadership compounds. We identify and activate the right communities, peer groups, and platforms where your voice will have the most impact, and build a strategy for showing up consistently and meaningfully. Examples include but are not limited to:

cards.heading: Community Mapping
cards.description: Identification of the top communities, peer groups, and platforms where your buyers and peers are most active.

cards.heading: Personal Narrative + Messaging
cards.description: A practical guide for how to show up in each community: what to say, how often, and what to avoid.

cards.heading: Speaking Opportunity Pipeline
cards.description: Ongoing research and submission of speaking proposals to relevant conferences and events on your behalf.

cards.heading: Podcast + Guest Feature Strategy
cards.description: Identification of relevant podcasts and guest article opportunities; pitch writing and outreach managed by MDCo.

cards.heading: Co-Marketing Opportunities
cards.description: Identification of vendor, partner, and peer collaboration opportunities to co-create content and expand reach.

cards.heading: LinkedIn Network Growth Plan
cards.description: Monthly connection strategy targeting ideal-profile contacts: buyers, press, peers, and conference organizers.

default.panel_subheading: Formalizing your knowledge into assets that work for you 24/7.
default.panel_description: Expertise is about packaging what you know into formats that scale. We turn your knowledge into reusable, high-credibility assets, frameworks, guides, and media, that continue building your reputation long after they're published. Examples include but are not limited to:

cards.heading: Signature Framework Development
cards.description: Facilitated development of 1 named, ownable framework or methodology that defines your approach and becomes your calling card.

cards.heading: Thought Leadership White Paper
cards.description: Annual long-form report or white paper (2,000-3,000 words) on a topic you own, gated for lead generation or used as a credibility asset.

cards.heading: Video Series (Quarterly)
cards.description: Script and production guidance for a quarterly short-form video, LinkedIn-native or YouTube, on a topic pillar.

cards.heading: Webinar / Panel Positioning
cards.description: Quarterly placement as a featured speaker or host on an MDCo-produced or partner webinar in your area of expertise.

cards.heading: MarketDesign Voices Feature
cards.description: Featured profile and contributed content placement within the MDCo MarketDesign Voices thought leadership program.

cards.heading: End-of-Year Impact Report
cards.description: Annual summary of your thought leadership activity, reach, and outcomes, shareable internally and with your board.
